Name: Animated Side Braid Hairstyle for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mjbfye.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I made this a while back to be part of an animated hairstyles pack, but I never got the others finished.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I decided to separate this one out and upload it though, in case anyone wants to use this one at least.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I plan to finish the other hairstyles when I'm able, but it may be a while still.[/size][/color][/center]
[center]♡ [/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Currently it's the sides of the hair around the face that mostly move. The movement I tried with[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]the braid itself always looked like too much, but if I work out a subtle animation I'm happy with[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]then I may add a 2nd version to the downloads.[/size][/color][/center]




[center][size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/wvlMKlE.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]FASHION SENSE[/url]![/color][/size][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the downloaded file and move the folder into your StardewValley/Mods folder. Done! [/color][/center]





[center]Thanks for checking out my mods!
﻿Follow me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]Ko-fi[/url]﻿ for updates![/center]
